My handwriting on paper

My handwriting: you can edit and extend it; it is saved on this phone.

Hand-drawn shapes: -> arrow, <- back, <-> both ways, => double, --- line, [] square, () circle, ^^ up; also work: ↓ Σ ° |. Example: []A -> [] B

Hand shadow

The shadow sits at the end of the text on the page. Move the sliders if needed.

Paper

Here you can photograph your notebook or an A4 sheet: the app writes the text right onto your photo.

Most natural look: photograph your empty notebook or sheet from above, upload the photo and mark the page corners. Paper automatically becomes “No lines” so your own lines are not doubled. The left and top text margins are set in “Paper and view”.

Upload a photo and press the button: 4 circles appear on the photo. Drag them to the corners of your sheet or notebook page and the text will follow the photo’s perspective. Then press “Done”.

All letters in one photo

Write the letters on a sheet in order, with clear gaps, in rows. Photograph the sheet straight from above so the paper fills the frame, with no shadows and no table edges.

“Draw a frame”: swipe a finger over the sheet to outline one letter. Frames line up in reading order (by rows, left to right) and each gets its letter from the list. In drawing mode the sheet does not scroll: choose “Remove frame” to scroll.

Fix individual letters (loaded: 0)

Upload one picture per letter (pen on a white background). In all pictures the baseline must be at the same level; tails (y, p, g) go below. Extra space left and right is trimmed automatically. If a letter is missing, a handwriting-style font is used.

Tap a letter tile and write it with your finger in the box below the tiles:

Writing letter: a

Put the bottom of the letter on the red line and press “Capture”. The next letter opens by itself.

The body of a lowercase letter sits between the blue middle line and the red line; capitals and tall letters reach the top line; tails (y, p, g) go below the red line. After saving, the next letter opens.

Ink

Write something with your pen on white paper (a couple of words or lines), photograph it from above in good light and upload it. The app takes the ink colour and density.
